These are substantive capability gaps supporting the ordinary human-level reading, rather than evidence based merely on occasional errors.

evidence_items.explanation: ARC Prize measured o1-preview at 21.2% on the public evaluation and 18% on the semi-private evaluation, alongside other contemporary LLMs. This supports the interpretation of limited adaptation while also documenting gains over GPT-4o; it is context because the tests extended beyond the target day.

This evaluation documents strengths across multiple domains, cautioning against portraying o1-preview as narrowly competent or incapable of reasoning. It describes progress toward AGI, and its later testing is not a measurement confined to launch day.
